subject.title: fix(browser): keep CDP cursor text previews UTF-16 safe

question: After real Chrome/CDP proof is added, should this smaller trailing-surrogate-scrubbing implementation become the canonical fix instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108316?
rationale: Both branches target the same defect, and repository automation should not choose which contributor branch to retain without maintainer review of their final heads and proof.

options.title: Prefer this PR
options.body: Retain this branch if its smaller diff and explicit length-equals-budget residue repair remain stronger after live proof and final CI.

options.title: Prefer the competing PR
options.body: Retain https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108316 if maintainers prefer its test shape or it supplies stronger real CDP proof first.

recommendation.title: Prefer this PR
recommendation.body: Retain this branch if its smaller diff and explicit length-equals-budget residue repair remain stronger after live proof and final CI.
